name: companionship
quote: I'm going to hang out with a friend tonight.
description: A sense that being with a particular person is positive, healthy, and an important part of your life. The relationship includes mutual respect, shared interests, and shared history.
perceptions: Experiences with this person are, on the balance, quite positive.
They are an important part of one of my identities.
We respect each other and have shared interests.

guidance.description: Online guides to making and maintaining friendships.

variations.name: well-rounded friendship
variations.description: A relationship between people who have seen each other in a variety of moods and contexts and still look forward to being around each other.
perceptions: Experiences with this person are, on the balance, quite positive.
They are an important part of many of my identities.
We respect each other and have shared interests.

variations.name: spiritual friendship
variations.description: A relationship between people who can share deep existential conversations.
perceptions: Experiences with this person are, on the balance, quite positive.
They are an important part of many of my existential identity.
We respect each other and are generally aligned on key philosophies.

guidance.description: In Western Culture’s expanding spiritual horizons, there are more ways to connect with people of all spiritual faiths and disciplines than ever before. This is the gift of technology and the Internet. With all these new opportunities, it is very easy to assume that if someone is spiritual, then they’re spiritual like you.

variations.name: hardship-tested ally
variations.description: A deeply trusting relationship formed in very difficult circumstances where loyalty and skill were rigorously tested.
perceptions: This person and I have a shared history in an unusually demanding situation.
Based on that experience, they know me better than most people and I can trust them.

variations.name: animal companion
variations.description: Looking forward to having repeated experiences with a particular animal that you view as an important part of your world.
perceptions: Interacting with this animal is always a positive experience.
I find it relaxing to be around this creature.

guidance.description: Before getting a pet, consider making sure your household is ready for one. See guidance for 'desire to be around animals'.

commentaries.quote: It's pretty common for us to work very hard over a long time to get a thumbs-up from friends.
The only way to have a friend is to be one.
The bird a nest, the spider a web, man friendship.
The language of friendship is not words but meanings.
Friendships reflect who we are, showing both our strengths and flaws. The people we choose to spend time with often reveal where we are in our personal growth.
